items.title: "A good sitter is not there to ..." said once
items.where: For the Person Helping: Calm Anchor, Not Guru, P1
items.my_version: The Zendo Project, a harm-reduction group that offers peer support at festivals and other events to people having a hard time in an altered state, sums up its approach in four principles: creating a safe space, sitting with the person rather than guiding them, talking them through it rather than down from it, and remembering that difficult isn't necessarily bad.
items.before: A good sitter is not there to win a philosophy debate, perform a rescue fantasy, impose an interpretation, or demonstrate spiritual advancement. The Zendo Project, a harm-reduction group that offers peer support at festivals and other events to people having a hard time in an altered state, sums up its approach in four principles: creating a safe space, sitting with the person rather than guiding them, talking them through it rather than down from it, and remembering that difficult isn't necessarily bad.
